common.description: Strings the site reuses on every page

loading.description: Shown beside a spinner while content is still loading.

show_more.description: Button that reveals the rest of a truncated grid of cards.

site_title.description: The browser tab title on any page that carries no title of its own. Also the site name search engines show.

site_description.description: The search-result and social-preview summary for any page that carries no description of its own. Around 160 characters reads best.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

dismiss.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that closes a notification banner.

close.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that closes the full-screen image viewer.

previous.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that moves back one item in a carousel or image viewer.

next.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that moves forward one item in a carousel or image viewer.

show_more_items.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Describes the "Show More" button. `%{count}` = how many further items it reveals, and selects the plural form.

breadcrumb.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the trail of parent links above a page title.

opens_in_new_tab.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Warns that a link opens a new browser tab. `%{label}` = the destination's own name (a social network, untranslated).

about_meditation.description: Header menu item opening the section that explains meditation. Repeated as a footer column heading.

featured_caption.description: Caption under the featured image inside an open header menu. A short evocative line, not a sentence.

footer.description: Footer headings and the copyright line

info.description: Heading of the footer column listing informational pages (about, contact, privacy).

languages.description: Label of the footer's language picker.

copyright.description: The copyright line at the very bottom. `%{year}` = the current year. Keep the © symbol.

errors.description: What a visitor sees when a page cannot load

heading.description: Heading above an error shown in place of a meditation or lecture player.

network_title.description: Error heading when the visitor's device cannot reach the site's servers.

server_title.description: Error heading when the servers are reachable but failing.

not_found_title.description: Error heading when the requested page or content does not exist.

unknown_title.description: Error heading for a failure that fits none of the other cases.

network_message.description: Explanation under `network_title`. Asks the visitor to check their internet connection.

server_message.description: Explanation under `server_title`. Says the problem is ours and is being worked on.

not_found_message.description: Explanation under `not_found_title`. Says the content may have moved or been deleted.

unknown_message.description: Explanation under `unknown_title`. Asks the visitor to try again.

status_page_hint.description: Line pointing at the service status page. `%{link}` = a link whose text is `status_page_link`.

status_page_link.description: The clickable words inside `status_page_hint`. Translate as a noun phrase, not a sentence.

try_again.description: Button that reloads the page after an error.

back_to_home.description: Button that leaves an error page for the home page.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

error_icon.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the warning icon above an error message.

article.description: Article pages, their author box, and the article index filters

written_by.description: Byline above an article's author box. `%{name}` = the author's name, rendered in italics.

name_with_country.description: An author's name and country on one line. `%{name}` = the author's name, `%{country}` = their country. Adjust the separator to suit the language.

meditating_years.description: How long an author has meditated, in their author box. `%{count}` = number of years, and selects the plural form.

reading_time.description: Estimated time to read an article. `%{count}` = number of minutes, and selects the plural form.

about_the_author.description: Heading above an author's biography at the end of an article.

filter_all.description: The filter chip that clears every tag and shows all articles. Sits in a row of chips, so it must stay short.

tag_wisdom.description: Name of the "Wisdom" article category, shown as a filter chip and on article cards.

tag_lifestyle.description: Name of the "Lifestyle" article category, shown as a filter chip and on article cards.

tag_creativity.description: Name of the "Creativity" article category, shown as a filter chip and on article cards.

tag_event.description: Name of the "Event" article category, shown as a filter chip and on article cards.

tag_technique.description: Name of the "Technique" article category, shown as a filter chip and on article cards.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

filter_label.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the row of tag filter chips above an article index.

meditation.description: The guided-meditation player and its page

label.description: Word marking the current track as a guided meditation, shown above its title.

founder_name.description: The name of the founder whose portrait appears in the player. A personal name — transliterate rather than translate.

founder_role.description: The word under the founder's name describing who she was. Lowercase in English.

voice.description: Label of the volume slider for the spoken guidance.

music.description: Label of the volume slider for the background music.

change_music.description: Tooltip on the button that swaps the background music for another track.

untitled.description: Stands in for a meditation's title when it has none.

missing_audio.description: Shown in place of the player when a meditation has no audio to play.

related_lectures.description: Heading above the talks suggested at the end of a meditation.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

mute_voice.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that silences the spoken guidance.

unmute_voice.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the same button once the guidance is silenced.

mute_music.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that silences the background music.

unmute_music.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the same button once the music is silenced.

voice_volume.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the slider controlling the spoken guidance.

music_volume.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the slider controlling the background music.

audio_settings.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the panel holding the volume sliders.

shuffle_music.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that picks a different background track at random.

related_lectures_loading.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Announced while the suggested talks are still loading.

missing_video.description: Shown in place of the video player when a talk has no video to play.

related_meditations.description: Heading above the meditations suggested at the end of a talk.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

related_meditations_loading.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Announced while the suggested meditations are still loading.

map.description: The class listings under /map, which crawlers and visitors without JavaScript read

online.description: Marks a class that meets over video rather than in a venue. Sits in a narrow badge, so an over-long translation will not save.

classes_shown.description: Says how much of a region's class list is on the page. `%{shown}` = how many are listed, `%{count}` = how many exist in total and selects the plural form.

no_classes.description: Shown instead of a class list when a region has none yet.

join_online.description: Link that takes a visitor to an online class's meeting room.

visit_website.description: Link that takes a visitor to a class's own website.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

classes_heading.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the list of classes on a region page.

when.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Introduces a class's day and time.

where.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Introduces a class's address.

languages.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Introduces the languages a class is taught in.

forms.description: Chrome shared by every form the site renders

field_required.description: Validation message under a mandatory field left empty. `%{field}` = that field's own label, which the editor writes and which is translated separately.

select_placeholder.description: Shown in a dropdown before the visitor picks anything.

submit_error.description: Shown when sending a form fails for a reason the site cannot name.

thank_you.description: Heading of the confirmation screen after a form is sent.

submitted.description: Line under `thank_you` confirming the form arrived.

submit.description: The button that sends a form, unless the editor gave it its own label.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

submitting.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Announced while a form is being sent.

required_marker.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Replaces the asterisk marking a mandatory field. One word.

media.description: The music player, content cards, images, and the embed popover

playlist.description: Heading above the list of tracks in the music player.

duration_minutes.description: A length in minutes, on a card or under a talk. `%{count}` = number of minutes, and selects the plural form. Abbreviate — the slot is tiny, and the limit counts `%{count}` itself, so about nine characters are left for your own words.

duration_seconds.description: A length in seconds, for anything under a minute. `%{count}` = number of seconds, and selects the plural form. Abbreviate — the slot is tiny, and the limit counts `%{count}` itself, so about nine characters are left for your own words.

embed.description: Button that opens the panel for putting this player on another website.

embed_title.description: Heading of that panel when the item has a title. `%{title}` = the item's own title. Use the quotation marks your language uses.

embed_player.description: Heading of that panel when the item has no title.

copy.description: Button that copies the embed code to the clipboard.

copied.description: Replaces `copy` for a moment after the code is copied.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

play.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that starts playback.

pause.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the same button during playback.

previous_track.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that goes back to the previous track.

next_track.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that skips to the next track.

toggle_shuffle.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that turns random order on or off.

mute.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that silences the player.

unmute.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the same button once the player is silenced.

volume.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the player's volume slider.

play_item.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the play button on a card. `%{title}` = that item's own title.

view_image.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that opens an image full screen, when the image has no caption.

view_image_alt.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. The same button when the image has a caption. `%{alt}` = that caption, which the editor writes.

embed_code.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the box holding the embed code.

zoom_in.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that enlarges an image in the full-screen viewer.

zoom_out.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that shrinks an image in the full-screen viewer.

location.description: The place-search box and its "near me" option

search_placeholder.description: Shown in the empty search box, before the visitor types a place.

change.description: Button that clears the chosen place and reopens the search box.

getting_coordinates.description: Shown while the site looks up the exact position of the place just chosen.

searching.description: Shown while place suggestions are being fetched.

type_to_search.description: Hint in the empty suggestion list, inviting the visitor to start typing.

no_results.description: Shown when no place matches what the visitor typed.

suggestions_failed.description: Error shown when the place suggestions cannot be fetched.

coordinates_failed.description: Error shown when the position of the chosen place cannot be fetched.

nearby.description: The option that searches around the visitor's own position instead of a typed place.

getting_location.description: Shown while the browser is working out where the visitor is.

current_location.description: Stands in for a place name once the visitor's own position is used.

geolocation_unsupported.description: Error shown when the visitor's browser cannot report a position at all.

permission_denied.description: Error shown when the visitor refused the browser's request for their position.

position_unavailable.description: Error shown when the browser tried but could not work out a position.

timed_out.description: Error shown when working out the visitor's position took too long.

location_failed.description: Error shown when finding the visitor's position failed for some other reason.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

search_label.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the place-search input.

selected_label.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the box showing the place already chosen.

change_label.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that changes the chosen place.

blocks.description: Blocks an editor drops into a page: the subtle-system diagram, countdowns, carousels, quotes, contents lists, and sharing

chakras.description: Tab of the subtle-system diagram showing the energy centres. A Sanskrit term — keep it if your language uses it.

channels.description: Tab of the subtle-system diagram showing the energy channels.

learn_more.description: Link from a chakra or channel to its full explanation. Keep the trailing arrow.

hours.description: Label under the hours figure of a countdown.

minutes.description: Label under the minutes figure of a countdown.

seconds.description: Label under the seconds figure of a countdown.

a11y.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers

enter_fullscreen.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that opens the subtle-system diagram full screen.

exit_fullscreen.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the same button while the diagram fills the screen.

learn_more_about.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the "Learn More" link. `%{title}` = the chakra or channel it leads to.

previous_slide.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that goes back one slide in a carousel.

next_slide.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that advances one slide in a carousel.

previous_column.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that scrolls to the previous column. `%{title}` = that column's heading.

next_column.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the button that scrolls to the next column. `%{title}` = that column's heading.

go_to_column.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names a dot that jumps to one column. `%{number}` = its position, `%{title}` = its heading.

quote.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names a pull-quote block that carries no heading.

table_of_contents.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the in-page contents list when it carries no heading.

share_region.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the whole sharing area at the end of a page.

share_group.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names the row of sharing buttons inside that area.

share_on.description: Not shown on screen; read by screen readers. Names one sharing button. `%{platform}` = the network's own name, untranslated.
